args.command:
mkdir -p out; python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, glob
lines = []
for f in glob.glob("logs/app-*.log"):
    lines += open(f).read().splitlines()
done = set(); errs = set()
for line in lines:
    m = re.match(r"^\S+\s+\S+\s+(\w+)\s+(req-\d+)", line)
    if not m: continue
    kind, req = m.group(1), m.group(2)
    if kind == "done": done.add(req)
    elif kind == "ERROR": errs.add(req)
stuck = sorted(r for r in errs if r not in done)
open("out/stuck.txt", "w").write("\n".join(stuck) + ("\n" if stuck else ""))
print(len(stuck), "stuck")
EOF
cat out/stuck.txt

import re, glob
done=set(); errs=set()
pat=re.compile(r"(done|ERROR)\s+(req-\d+)")
for f in glob.glob("logs/app-*.log"):
    for line in open(f):
        m=pat.search(line)
        if m: (done if m.group(1)=="done" else errs).add(m.group(2))
stuck=sorted(r for r in errs if r not in done)
open("out/stuck.txt","w").write("\n".join(stuck)+"\n")
print(len(stuck),"stuck of",len(errs),"errors")
for r in stuck: print(r, "done?", r in done)
EOF
cat out/stuck.txt
